name: ranch-desert
description: Ranch, the desert look (ROADMAP 49.10e): the shipped Ranch drawn again as a caravan town's horse and camel stable: a mud-brick hay tower crowned with merlons and a windcatcher over two flat-roofed stall ranges of coursed sandstone, an arched gateway with the ranch's banner over a walled yard and its stone trough, and (II) a bunk house behind an arcaded loggia and an adobe-pier corral with date palms. MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. 'build' writes candidates.
